title: Pricing
content: AgentDesk AI offers a starter plan for small businesses, a growth plan for teams, and an enterprise plan for custom integrations. For serious leads, suggest a demo call and collect their business type, expected monthly conversations, and required channels.

title: Integrations
content: AgentDesk AI can integrate with websites, WhatsApp, email, CRM systems, and internal knowledge bases. Advanced integrations may require custom setup.

title: Activation Support
content: If a customer has paid but their account is not active, apologize, collect payment email and transaction ID, and escalate to a human support specialist.

title: Demo Booking
content: For high-intent leads, ask them to book a 30-minute demo. Collect company name, use case, number of users, and preferred contact details.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are reviewed case by case. If the customer is angry or mentions payment failure, escalate to human support.
